definitions.gloss: reminder letter; demand notice; dunning letter
definitions.explanation: A written notice urging someone to fulfill an overdue obligation, such as paying a bill or returning a borrowed item. Firmer in tone than a simple reminder.

examples.japanese: {督促状|とくそくじょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}いた→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
⟦{家賃|やちん}→家賃：03639_yachin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{督促状|とくそくじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{取|と}った→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧。
examples.english: I received a demand notice for overdue rent.

examples.japanese: ⟦{図書館|としょかん}→図書館：00580_toshokan⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{返却|へんきゃく}→返却：03149_henkyaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{督促状|とくそくじょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{送|おく}られて→送る：00742_okuru⟧きた。
examples.english: The library sent a reminder to return the books.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{督促|とくそく}→督促：09002_tokusoku⟧ (urging, pressing) + ⟦{状|じょう}→状：09878_jou⟧ (letter, document). Sent when a deadline has already passed, so it carries more pressure than a friendly reminder.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {督促状|とくそくじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧: to send a demand notice
- {支払|しはら}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{督促状|とくそくじょう}: a payment demand notice

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{催促|さいそく}→催促：04159_saisoku⟧: pressing for something — the act, spoken or written
- ⟦{請求書|せいきゅうしょ}→請求書：04698_seikyuusho⟧: invoice, bill — the original demand for payment, not the overdue reminder
